object: LLM multi-agent conceptual engineering design workflow
problem: Can an LLM agentic framework grounded in design methodology improve conceptual engineering design quality and creativity?
mechanism_or_method: Multi-agent LLM collaboration integrating design methodologies with coverage, diversity and novelty metrics for problem refinement, exploration and optimization.
limitation: Evaluation relies on benchmark comparisons and user studies; no built or tested designs reported.
decision_relevance: Which AI tooling to use for early-stage engineering concept generation.

object: artificial pathogen cells with tunable rigidity and macrophages
problem: How do macrophages sense and respond to the rigidity of cell-presented mechanical signals?
mechanism_or_method: Model protocells with tunable rigidity co-incubated with macrophages to reveal pseudopodia-mediated mechanosensing through molecular clutch and actin assembly.
limitation: Artificial in vitro model; in vivo pathogen mechanics and relevance not demonstrated.

object: shape memory polymer adhesive for dynamic capture
problem: How to capture high-energy moving objects with adhesive while suppressing rebound without complex control?
mechanism_or_method: Sequential phase-switching adhesion using shape memory polymer frame structure whose viscoelasticity dissipates impact energy and strengthens the interface dynamically.
limitation: Demonstrated only under laboratory free-floating conditions, not in actual space environments.
decision_relevance: Choice of adhesive grippers for on-orbit capture of moving targets.

problem: How to achieve many reversible shape changes in soft continuum robots with minimal actuators?
mechanism_or_method: Exploit friction-induced shape hysteresis via inverted zigzag tendon-sheath mechanism with two sequentially controlled actuators, supported by mechanics and kinematics models.
limitation: Validated on lab prototypes in benchtop environments; not tested in surgical or inspection settings.
decision_relevance: Actuation architecture for hyperredundant soft robots with few actuators.

object: cation-exchanged Linde Type A zeolites for Xe/Kr separation
problem: How to achieve highly selective xenon/krypton separation despite their similar properties?
mechanism_or_method: Ag+ and Ca2+ cation exchange in LTA zeolite creates a gating sieving effect with size-inverse selectivity, confirmed by breakthrough, diffraction, XAS and DFT.
limitation: Lab-scale breakthrough tests; silver cost and long-term stability not addressed.

object: porous MXene nanosheet membranes for H2/CO2 separation
problem: How do in-plane pores and interlayer spacing jointly govern gas transport in 2D nanosheet membranes?
mechanism_or_method: Engineer in-plane pores in MXene nanosheets with controlled interlayer spacing, giving dual-channel sieving where pores boost permeance and spacing sets selectivity.
limitation: Performance shown at lab to meter-scale membranes; long-term stability under industrial gas streams not reported.

problem: How to reverse the usual adsorption preference to obtain pure C2H2 from ternary C2 mixtures in one step?
mechanism_or_method: Ligand functionalization places methyl groups in cages to strengthen C2H4 and C2H6 binding while suppressing C2H2, verified by DFT and crystallography.
limitation: Lab-scale breakthrough; scalability and cost of the linker are not demonstrated.

object: melt-spun and powder-metallurgy Bi0.4Sb1.6Te3 thermoelectric alloys
problem: Is the reduced lattice thermal conductivity in melt-spun Bi0.4Sb1.6Te3 real or misattributed due to the Lorenz number?
mechanism_or_method: Measure thermal conductivity at low temperature and high magnetic field to isolate lattice part, revealing anomalous Lorenz number from inelastic scattering.
limitation: Result established on two samples at low temperatures; extrapolation to operating temperature is indirect.
decision_relevance: How to attribute thermal conductivity gains when optimizing thermoelectric coolers.

problem: Can a non-toxic, stretchable, recyclable thermoelectric material enable dual-mode temperature and pressure sensing?
mechanism_or_method: Ionic thermoelectric hydrogel encapsulated in recyclable polyurethane combining thermoelectric and triboelectric sensing, with recycling and self-healing.
limitation: Lab device characterization only; long-term wearable durability not shown.

problem: How to make polyamide membranes with better microstructure using less harmful solvents in a scalable way?
mechanism_or_method: Interfacial polymerization at ionic liquid/water interface combined with doctor blading to control reaction kinetics and thermodynamics.
limitation: Lab-scale membrane coupons; ionic liquid cost, recovery and long-term fouling not covered.

problem: How to distinguish frequency components of elastic waves passively using a metasurface without large meta-atom libraries?
mechanism_or_method: Thickness-controlled meta-atom phase profiles from Kirchhoff-Love plate theory multiplex frequencies, with piezoelectric element converting focused energy to a signal.
limitation: Demonstrated on laboratory plates; robustness to real structural noise and boundaries unclear.
decision_relevance: Passive spectral sensing option for plate-based structural monitoring.

object: polymer glass formers with varying chain length
problem: Why do glass transition temperature and fragility depend on chain length and end groups?
mechanism_or_method: Correlate number of chain ends within cooperatively rearranging regions with Tg and fragility, proposing an index of rigidity for end groups.
limitation: Abstract does not state how broadly the correlation holds beyond studied polymers.

object: optically trapped microparticles under finite-time protocols
problem: Can thermodynamically optimal transport with minimal dissipation be realized experimentally, including optimal information erasure?
mechanism_or_method: Scanning optical tweezers generate arbitrary potentials to implement optimal finite-time protocols, confirming Wasserstein-distance bound on excess dissipation.
limitation: Microscale colloidal experiment; applicability to engineered devices remains to be shown.

object: pedestrian collisions involving electric and combustion vehicles
problem: Are electric vehicles more dangerous to pedestrians than internal combustion vehicles in collision likelihood and injury severity?
mechanism_or_method: Statistical analysis of Great Britain STATS19 road safety records comparing fully electric, hybrid and combustion vehicles.
limitation: Observational data with possible confounding in exposure and driving context; hybrid result only speculatively explained.
decision_relevance: Whether EV-specific pedestrian safety measures are warranted.

problem: How to reduce the energy penalty of regenerating NH3-adsorbing MOFs?
mechanism_or_method: Radical formation on bipyridinium upon NH3 adsorption yields photothermal heating under 808 nm laser, triggering localized NH3 desorption.
limitation: Gram-scale lab demonstration; laser-driven regeneration efficiency at process scale not shown.

object: rare-earth magnesium alloy with Mn-Al-B gradient ordered architectures
problem: How to combine low thermal expansion with high strength and ductility in magnesium alloys?
mechanism_or_method: Al diffusion into Mn-B particles forms nanoscale multi-gradient ordered Mn-Al-B interfaces that convert brittle boundaries into energy-absorbing zones.
limitation: Compression data only; tensile, fatigue and creep behavior not reported.
decision_relevance: Alloy design for dimensionally stable lightweight aerospace components.

object: interfacial water films on calcium hydroxide for CO2 mineralization
problem: Can confining water to nanometre films accelerate mineral carbonation under ambient conditions?
mechanism_or_method: Thinning interfacial water film below 8.5 nm creates confined pocket sites with oriented hydroxyls that organize CO2 and ions, speeding carbonation 16-fold.
limitation: Bench-scale reactions; gigatonne-scale deployment and energy accounting remain unproven.

object: ionic glass formers, ionomers and polymerized ionic liquids
problem: Does the empirical correlation between fragility and non-exponential relaxation hold for ionic glass formers?
mechanism_or_method: Synthesize cross-linked charged polymers and survey ionic liquids and ionomers to show an inverted fragility versus stretching trend.
limitation: Microscopic origin attributed to long-range ionic interactions only by suggestion, not proven.

object: hyaluronic acid and phospholipid assemblies in synovial lubrication
problem: How does hyaluronic acid molecular weight control lipid assembly structure and friction in healthy versus osteoarthritic joints?
mechanism_or_method: Mixed-MW HA with phospholipids form lamellae or vesicles at interfaces, with friction measured at physiological shear rates.
limitation: Simplified model system lacks biochemical complexity of real synovial fluid.
decision_relevance: Design of structure-informed viscosupplements and biomimetic lubricants.

problem: How to 4D print complex, high-resolution LCE structures with programmable shape change using vat photopolymerization?
mechanism_or_method: DLP print LCE, apply mechanical programming post-print, then thermal treatment forms covalent links to lock the programmed shape.
limitation: Programming relies on manual mechanical deformation; reversibility and cycling life not detailed.
decision_relevance: Manufacturing route for programmable shape-changing actuators and soft robots.

problem: How to produce mechanically robust, scalable hydrogels made solely of biomass DNA?
mechanism_or_method: Fast-shrinking-induced entanglement restricts chain relaxation of ultra-long DNA, boosting entanglement density beyond the threshold for high strength.
limitation: Properties shown at lab scale; water-environment durability and cost of DNA supply unclear.

problem: Does chemical short-range order exist in covalent high-entropy carbides and how does it affect radiation resistance?
mechanism_or_method: Combine atomistic simulations with scanning transmission electron microscopy to detect and control CSRO via composition and heat treatment.
limitation: CSRO is not the only factor in radiation resistance; quantitative contribution unresolved.
decision_relevance: Composition and annealing choices for radiation-tolerant ceramics.

problem: Can defects be used to raise electrical conductivity of metals beyond pure annealed levels?
mechanism_or_method: Heterogeneous interface-assisted plastic deformation creates severe lattice distortion and local stress that suppresses electron-phonon coupling, giving over 110% IACS.
limitation: Scalability of processing and thermal stability of distorted lattice not reported in abstract.
decision_relevance: Processing routes for high-conductivity copper conductors.

problem: How to achieve high-temperature H2/N2 separation with high permeance and selectivity?
mechanism_or_method: Confine graphene nanoribbons in ZIF-8 fillers embedded in polyimide, with techno-economic analysis of NH3 cracking.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; long-term stability at 300 C and process-scale validation not shown.
decision_relevance: Operating temperature for membrane H2 separation in ammonia cracking.

problem: What are the intrinsic in-plane shear modulus and wrinkle resistance of monolayer MXene?
mechanism_or_method: Direct in-situ push-to-shear testing of single nanosheets under scanning electron microscope.
limitation: Single-crystal monolayers tested in vacuum; behavior in practical films and environments unknown.
decision_relevance: Reliability assumptions for MXene in flexible electronics and membranes.

problem: How to directly regenerate degraded NCM523 cathodes into dense single-crystal material?
mechanism_or_method: Oxidation converts surface NiO to NiOOH and bulk Ni2+ to Ni3+, rebuilding Li+ channels and breaking secondary particles before calcination.
limitation: Lab-scale regeneration from specific chemistry; process economics and mixed waste streams not addressed.

problem: Can moisture-driven electricity from hand-induced air turbulence power a noncontact gesture interface?
mechanism_or_method: Ion-doped hydrogel generates voltage from ambient moisture; hand motion alters humidity and pressure, decoded by machine learning for gesture recognition.
limitation: Short 8 cm range and lab conditions; sensitivity to ambient humidity changes not addressed.

object: hierarchical textile fibers for wearable atmospheric water harvesting
problem: How to overcome kinetic limits when scaling sorbents into practical wearable water harvesters?
mechanism_or_method: Fibers with open-pore surface and hierarchical internal pores accelerate vapor liquefaction and transport; woven into breathable textiles with a portable collector.
limitation: Prototype tested under controlled humidity; real wearing conditions and durability not demonstrated.

problem: Why does the elastic limit of metallic glasses increase with temperature in certain ranges?
mechanism_or_method: Molecular dynamics with energy-strain landscape from high-throughput barrier calculations shows shear transformations shifting from irreversible to reversible; analytical model predicts transition.
limitation: Simulated CuZr at MD time scales and cooling rates; experimental confirmation not given.

problem: Can topological pentagon states of a giant closed-cage fullerene be visualized in a macroscopic acoustic analog?
mechanism_or_method: 3D print hollow tube and cavity network mimicking C540 topology and map pentagon states in real space using sound waves.
limitation: Classical acoustic analog; relation to real fullerene electronic properties is by analogy.

object: global emissions of CFC-113, CFC-114 and CFC-115 from HFC production
problem: Do unreported feedstock and by-product CFC flows in HFC production explain unexpected CFC emissions?
mechanism_or_method: Bayesian framework jointly infers CFC emissions during HFC-134a and HFC-125 production using observation-derived emissions and production data.
limitation: Uncertainties in chemical manufacturing processes and unreported production limit attribution.

object: surface-assembled amphiphiles on materials for haptic energy harvesters
problem: How do amphiphile conformations tune friction, tactile perception and triboelectric output under compression?
mechanism_or_method: Small amphiphiles with pi-pi stacking form slip planes cutting friction 80-90%; a scaling framework accounts for adhesion and contact mechanics.
limitation: Lab tribology and small perception tests; scale-up and wear over long use unaddressed.
decision_relevance: Surface coating choice balancing friction and triboelectric output in haptic harvesters.

problem: How do material and printing parameters govern thermo-electro-mechanical response of filament-extruded conductive polymers?
mechanism_or_method: Multi-scale framework: full-field homogenisation of mesostructure feeding a macroscopic continuum model, validated with original multi-physical experiments.
limitation: Validated on specific conductive filaments and geometries; generality across materials unclear.
decision_relevance: Choosing print parameters for functional conductive printed parts.

object: near-surface ground materials after large earthquakes
problem: What controls the recovery duration of shallow subsurface damage after earthquake shaking?
mechanism_or_method: Ambient noise interferometry seismic velocity records across two large earthquakes and aftershocks show constant relaxation time scale independent of shaking intensity.
limitation: Limited to two earthquake sequences; state-variable explanation only suggested.
decision_relevance: Predicting post-earthquake recovery timing for ground and site hazard assessment.

object: anisotropic thermal diffusivity of polycrystalline Bi2Te3
problem: How to measure local anisotropic thermal diffusivity directly and nondestructively in polycrystals?
mechanism_or_method: Thermal diffusivity microscope with micro four-point probe measuring thermal delay from a single heater, requiring no calibration.
limitation: Demonstrated on a single prototypical material; broader material range not shown.
decision_relevance: Thermal characterization method for anisotropic thermoelectric and electronic materials.

object: martensitic ferroelastic alloys such as Ti78Nb22 for solid-state heat pumping
problem: Can reversible linear elastic deformation heating give far higher heat-pumping efficiency than phase-transition materials?
mechanism_or_method: Stress along directions of giant linear thermal expansion in martensite yields large adiabatic temperature change without hysteresis, shown on [100]-oriented Ti78Nb22.
limitation: Material-level COP only; device-level efficiency and 5 K temperature change limit practical heat pumping.
decision_relevance: Material choice for elastocaloric style solid-state heat pumps.

problem: How to make brittle metal oxide films fracture resistant for ultrathin flexible encapsulation?
mechanism_or_method: In-situ nano-oxide HEO scaffold within hydrogel forms dual-phase nanostructure with hierarchical toughening that deflects cracks.
limitation: Encapsulation tested at limited bending strain and lab conditions; large-area manufacturing not shown.

object: microfluidic channels with hierarchically assembled obstacles
problem: How to design microchannels for complex flow manipulation quickly and flexibly?
mechanism_or_method: Hierarchically assembled obstacles with neural network CEyeNet predicting transformed flow profiles, speeding computation up to 2700-fold.
limitation: Prediction accuracy is 90% against experiments; limited to the studied flow regime and obstacle set.
decision_relevance: Microchannel obstacle layout selection for target flow shapes.

object: graphene oxide and MXene anisotropic actuating membranes
problem: How can pH-programmed edge protonation drive directional bending in 2D membranes?
mechanism_or_method: Differential flake protonation creates top-bottom chemical gradient causing localized strain and flake sliding during thermal dehydration, bending the membrane.
limitation: Lab-scale demonstrations; cycling durability and humidity dependence in real settings unclear.

object: poly(ionic liquid)/ionic liquid cocrystal ionogel adhesive
problem: How to reconcile strong adhesion with fast reversible switching in smart adhesives?
mechanism_or_method: Alkyl chain cocrystallization with tunable melting gives ultrafast phase transition, switching adhesion over 120-fold and electrical signal feedback.
limitation: Switching tied to temperature thresholds; durability over many cycles and on rough surfaces not stated.

problem: Why do nominally stable faults host induced earthquakes, and how does that change later hazard?
mechanism_or_method: Numerical models bridging geological and earthquake timescales show frictional healing builds strength released at nucleation, altering nucleation and later rupture.
limitation: Purely numerical with assumed friction parameters; not calibrated against specific induced earthquake cases.
decision_relevance: Seismic hazard assessment for induced earthquakes in subsurface energy projects.

problem: Can arsenic removed from groundwater be converted into valuable pure metallic arsenic nanoparticles?
mechanism_or_method: Two-stage process of alkali extraction followed by selective reduction yields pure amorphous As(0) nanoparticles.
limitation: Lab-scale conversion; economics and safe handling of metallic arsenic at scale not quantified.

problem: How to boost hydrovoltaic output independent of evaporation direction by replacing metal-sheet electrodes?
mechanism_or_method: Foamed iron electrode with ZIF-67 raising surface potential combined with melamine foam and carbon cloth anode with CNTs.
limitation: Small lab devices; long-term stability and power under outdoor conditions not reported.

problem: How to overcome the hardness-toughness trade-off in diamond materials?
mechanism_or_method: Curved graphite precursors concentrate stress under 15 GPa and 2300 K to nucleate hexagonal diamond in cubic matrix, giving stacking-fault interlocking.
limitation: Requires high-pressure synthesis yielding small samples; scalability is asserted not demonstrated.
decision_relevance: Precursor design for tougher superhard diamond tool materials.

problem: How to jointly program appearance, texture, mechanics and shape in one stimulus-responsive film like cephalopod skin?
mechanism_or_method: Binary halftone patterns of highly and lightly crosslinked domains regulate polymer-solvent interaction and microstructure heterogeneity.
limitation: Hydrogel responses depend on solvent and temperature; response speed and durability not detailed.

object: MOF-polyamine-COF core-shell-shell nanocomposites for CO2 capture
problem: How to combine high CO2 capacity with chemical and humidity stability in sorbents?
mechanism_or_method: MOF core enriches CO2, entangled polyamine shell gives dual amine sites, and COF outer shell protects against humidity and harsh chemicals.
limitation: Cycling tested under simulated flue gas only; real flue gas contaminants and cost not assessed.

object: conjugated microporous polymer membranes for organic solvent nanofiltration
problem: How does applied voltage control solute rejection in organic solvent nanofiltration?
mechanism_or_method: Conductive CMP membranes under voltage show dual-barrier rejection from ion migration and Donnan-like equilibrium, raising dye rejection from 8.3% to 91.3%.
limitation: Rejection depends on solute dissociation; lab dead-end tests with limited solvents and compounds.

object: noisy microscopic systems driven by non-equilibrium forces
problem: How to optimally extract work by exploiting the temporal structure of non-equilibrium driving forces?
mechanism_or_method: Exact analytical optimal protocols and a quasistatic work bound derived for arbitrary forces and durations, using initial state information.
limitation: Theory with illustrative examples only; no experimental realization or hardware constraints considered.

problem: Can solvothermal synthesis temperature precisely tune pore structure for discriminating similar gases?
mechanism_or_method: Adjust synthesis temperature to obtain a series of frameworks with tunable pores, with DFT confirming pore-environment-driven selectivity.
limitation: Lab-scale adsorption measurements; industrial mixed-gas performance not shown.

problem: Why do moisture-harvesting hydrogels degrade and how can long-term stability be achieved?
mechanism_or_method: Systematic aging tests show copper-mediated hydroxyl radical degradation; protective coatings prevent it, enabling over 190 sorption cycles.
limitation: Mechanism is proposed and consistent with observations; tested on limited hydrogel and metal combinations.
decision_relevance: Material selection and coatings for atmospheric water harvesting devices with metal parts.

object: EGaIn liquid metal oxide skin on substrates
problem: Why does peeling of gallium-based liquid metal oxide leave residue, and how can it be avoided?
mechanism_or_method: Maintaining a large contact angle during slow delamination avoids oxide skin fracture at the oxide-air interface, shown by experiments and theory.
limitation: Slow delamination regime on tested substrates; high-speed processes not covered.
decision_relevance: Process parameters for residue-free patterning of liquid metal electronics.

object: yield-stress inks printed in a fluid bath
problem: How to make 3D soft architectures by self-assembly of 2D printed patterns without nozzle or rheology constraints?
mechanism_or_method: Transformable embedded ink writing uses density contrast and gravitational-buoyancy forces to drive printed filaments up or down into predefined 3D shapes.
limitation: Needs density-matched inks and baths; precision and scale-up of the transformations not quantified.

object: Fe-FER zeolite catalyst for methanol selective catalytic reduction of NOx
problem: How to raise low-temperature deNOx activity of methanol-SCR and identify the active sites?
mechanism_or_method: Zeolitic acid sites cooperate with single iron redox sites; in situ Mossbauer spectroscopy captures [FeO]+ forming HONO intermediate.
limitation: Pilot bench test only; durability under real engine exhaust poisons not shown.

problem: How to combine silk-like strength-toughness with rapid hydration-driven contraction in artificial fibers?
mechanism_or_method: Nanoconfined entanglement-enhanced phase separation of bottlebrush composite slurry gives multiscale energy dissipation, 1652 MJ/m3 toughness and 76% contraction.
limitation: Lab-spun fibers; actuation cycling life and scalable spinning not addressed in abstract.

problem: How can millirobots generate large thrust to move through high-friction and confined environments?
mechanism_or_method: Dual coils accelerate an internal permanent magnet that strikes the end wall, converting momentum into over 15 N instantaneous thrust.
limitation: Tethered power and lab terrains; impulsive motion control and wear not discussed.
decision_relevance: Actuation design for millirobots working in sand, oil and tubes.

problem: How to decode and inversely design property-governing geometric features of disordered metamaterials from few samples?
mechanism_or_method: Physics-guided self-supervised generative networks with a formula writing module identify geometric invariants, then invert formulae to design new structures.
limitation: Trained from a small, expanding dataset requiring experiments; generality across property types unclear.
decision_relevance: How to design disordered microstructures to hit target bulk properties.

problem: How to build chemically robust COF membranes for molecular desalination in strong acid?
mechanism_or_method: Monomer-solvent dual engineering enables one-step interfacial polymerization of thiazole-linked conjugated COFs with hydration layer and electrostatic regulation.
limitation: Lab membrane tests; long-term operation with real pharmaceutical streams not demonstrated.

problem: How to systematically design woven metamaterials to access the compliant, stretchable regime with programmable failure?
mechanism_or_method: Graph-based geometric framework encodes woven topology; microscale in situ tension tests and computational mechanics map stiffness and stretchability.
limitation: Microscale specimens tested; manufacturability and behavior at larger scales are not shown.
decision_relevance: Architecture choice for highly compliant, programmable-failure lattice materials.

problem: How can plastic localization be suppressed to improve mechanical and fatigue performance?
mechanism_or_method: Competition between nanoscale twinning and slip within narrow stacking fault energy range dynamically homogenizes plasticity, termed dynamic plastic deformation delocalization.
limitation: Occurs only within a narrow stacking fault energy window; alloy range tested is limited.
decision_relevance: Alloy composition selection to raise fatigue strength via stacking fault energy.

object: liquid crystal elastomers printed by six-axis robotic arm
problem: How to 4D print LCEs conformally onto complex nonplanar 3D substrates beyond 2D-plane alignment?
mechanism_or_method: Algorithm generates printing paths, point normals and control codes for robotic direct-ink-writing, integrated with 3D scanning for unknown geometries.
limitation: Demonstrations on selected surfaces; accuracy limits and actuation performance after printing not quantified.
decision_relevance: Printing route for shape-changing coatings on curved parts.
